fact: The chamber is vast, containing a central rocky mesa with crude ramps winding upward and a bridge connecting its topmost tiers.
source_quote: a great rocky mesa at the cavern's center. Crude ramps wound upward to the mesa's topmost tiers, which were connected by a sturdy bridge
subject: The Obelisk Chamber

fact: The obelisk is a fifty-foot-tall structure of smooth black metal with a handful of imperfections as though pieces had been chipped away.
source_quote: a fifty-foot-tall obelisk of smooth black metal, its surface marred by only a handful of imperfections, as though pieces of it had been chipped away over time
subject: the obelisk

fact: A dragon egg sits atop one of the mesa's tiers.
source_quote: Atop one tier sat the dragon egg
subject: the dragon egg

fact: Plinki is a female derro who is stroking the obelisk's surface with reverent intensity.
source_quote: Beside the obelisk stood a female derro named Plinki, stroking its surface with the reverent intensity of a scientist on the edge of a great discovery
subject: Plinki

fact: Plinki scribbles notes in a small book while observing the obelisk.
source_quote: scribbling notes in a small book
subject: Plinki's notebook

fact: Plinki has a crowd of minions, some of whom are possibly invisible or hidden.
source_quote: She had a crowd of minions, some possibly invisible or hidden
subject: Plinki's minions

fact: Themberchaud is referenced as a contact to whom the party could report the destruction of the egg.
source_quote: they could destroy it and report that to Themberchaud
subject: Themberchaud

fact: Gyrgum is a cleric of the dragon god Bahamut.
source_quote: Gyrgum, drawn irresistibly toward the egg by his devotion to Bahamut... announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum announces himself to Plinki as a cleric of Bahamut come to worship at the egg.
source_quote: announced himself as a cleric of the dragon god come to worship at the egg
subject: Gyrgum's bluff

fact: Demogorgon is referenced by Plinki as the entity who sent Gyrgum to acknowledge her achievement.
source_quote: she declared that Demogorgon himself had sent this holy man to acknowledge the greatness of her achievement
subject: Demogorgon

fact: The Keepers of the Flame are the original owners from whom the dragon egg was stolen.
source_quote: The egg had been stolen from the Keepers of the Flame
subject: Keepers of the Flame

fact: Intricate incantations have been inscribed across the surface of the dragon egg.
source_quote: she showed him the intricate incantations she had inscribed across the egg's surface
subject: demonic incantations

fact: Daz rolled a natural 20 on Arcana to read the egg's etchings.
source_quote: Earlier, Daz had rolled a natural 20 on Arcana and read the egg's etchings
subject: Daz

fact: The egg's etchings indicate it will hatch a two-headed dragon, likely possessed by a demonic power.
source_quote: it would hatch a two-headed dragon, likely possessed by some demonic power
subject: egg's hatching prediction

fact: Thorin initially interpreted the egg's etchings as festival decorations.
source_quote: Thorin had taken the same etchings for festival decorations
subject: Thorin

fact: Gyrgum casts Bless on his companions, claiming magnanimity.
source_quote: Gyrgum casts Bless on his companions "in my magnanimity."
subject: Gyrgum casts Bless

fact: Zalthir states that the dragon egg is demonic.
subject: Zalthir
